answer: Like a root network feeding on subterranean nectar, decentralized consensus sustains honest nodes while pruning phantom duplicates. Like a willow bending resiliently against harsh winds rather than snapping, the system resists infiltration through stake-weighted graph centrality. A malicious clone acts as a hollow mirror, merely reflecting fabricated interactions; forging reciprocal trust paths imposes superlinear attacker cost that rapidly renders Sybil multiplication economically unviable.
